build_policy_validator: build a PolicyValidator instance to validate policy configurations against guardrail registry, database, and router
test_validate_policies: test the PolicyValidator.validate_policies method to validate a dict of Policy objects for guardrails, pipelines, and inheritance
test_validate_policy_config: test the PolicyValidator.validate_policy_config method to parse and validate a raw policy config dict from YAML
test_check_model_exists: test the PolicyValidator.check_model_exists method to verify a model name exists in the router or matches a wildcard pattern
test_check_team_alias_exists: test the PolicyValidator.check_team_alias_exists method to verify a team alias exists in the database
